canonical_project: China Mobile Tibet Lhasa Data Center
notes: County-government repost says China Mobile (Tibet Lhasa) Data Center phase I electromechanical works were completed and put into operation. The Lhasa High-Tech Zone key project had total investment of 739m yuan, 63 mu site, 51,405 m2 building area and 6,600 designed server cabinets, built to high national standards for IDC + cloud services. MW not disclosed.
